title: Complete ordinary non-hostile animals sprint
acceptance_criteria: Resolved prototype inheritance/defaults drive animal enrollment, medical/analyzer state and rendering.
Shipped character/reagent catalogs survive production sync encoding, assembly and decoding with resolved character policies available.
An isolated real client sends CHARACTER Ready for the server-committed epoch/body and retains the connection during a bounded hold.
All 36 hosts bind 40 allowed appearances; legacy mouse/pig/villager/sheep behavior is preserved.
Four flyers reuse movement/prediction for takeoff/flight/landing, obey medical/containment gates, and keep throw-flight separate.
Only monkey/kobold/scurret have one hand and ComplexInteraction; typed equipment fitting and one-hand clients work.
Typed portability, Normal/Tiny storage and escape timing preserve body identity through custody/escape.
Typed source-opt-in melee retaliates only when provoked and autonomous; no proactive attacks.
Cow/goat milking, chicken/duck eggs, parrot memory, moproach cleaning and source speech use shared live services/native fixtures.
A freshly built jar is ready for MANUAL.md owner checks, with unsupported systems and connected/visual boundaries explicit.
UI/interaction/prediction readiness passes without claiming animal-native or authenticated proof.
manual_steps: Join normally first: camera binds to the character, move/jump/look control it, and no readiness timeout occurs; stop on failure without editing profiles or deleting worlds.
Follow MANUAL.md setup and expected results for models/analyzer, takeover, flight/landing, one-hand equipment, custody/escape, milk, eggs, parrot speech and moproach cleaning.
Check identity and second-player appearance/held-item visibility; keep connected camera/prediction and native visuals separate from automated evidence.

argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $base=(Join-Path (Get-Location) 'build/gametest-tags-fixture'); $baseFull=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($base); $repoFull=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Get-Location).Path); if (-not $baseFull.StartsWith((Join-Path $repoFull 'build') + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Fixture root is outside repo/build' }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $baseFull -Force | Out-Null; $fixture=Join-Path $baseFull ('fresh-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); $fixtureFull=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($fixture); if (-not $fixtureFull.StartsWith($baseFull + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Generated GameTest directory escaped fixture root' }; ./gradlew.bat runGameTestServer "-Pms14GameTestDir=$fixtureFull" --no-configuration-cache --no-build-cache; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; if ($code -eq 0) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $fixtureFull -Recurse -Force } else { Write-Host "Failed GameTest directory retained: $fixtureFull" }; exit $code
checks.rationale: Full unfiltered native suite including new fixtures, isolated under the dedicated repo/build fixture root. Use a unique fresh Gradle gameDirectory every invocation so no persisted world or config state leaks between runs; remove it only on success and retain the whole directory on failure. Report selected/total/pass/fail counts.
